report.summary: Touch + push-to-talk thermostat panel on the ESP32-S31 Korvo-1 that shows four rooms and publishes TRV setpoints straight to zigbee2mqtt topics, with permit-join and a settings web page.

report.deviceType: Wall/desk heating panel for a Home Assistant house with four Zigbee TRVs on zigbee2mqtt. One always-on screen shows bathroom, hallway, office and living room with current (air sensor) and target (TRV-reported) temperatures; targets are changed by touching −/+ on a selected room or by pressing a front button and saying one sentence. Setpoints are published directly onto each TRV's zigbee2mqtt state topic, so no Home Assistant automation is involved. The boiler is not controlled.

hardware.gpios: No external wiring: RGB LCD 40/43/44/45, GT1151 touch on I2C GPIO0/1, ES8389 codec 3–7, WS2812 LED GPIO37, boot button GPIO61, ADC front-button group (SET/MODE/VOL+/VOL−), microSD 20–25.
peripherals: ESP32-S31-Korvo-1 on-board RGB LCD — dashboard and feedback overlays
GT1151 touch panel — room selection, −/+, mic and permit-join controls
ES8389 mic — one-shot voice capture (speaker unused, no spoken replies)
Front buttons (ADC group) + boot button — push-to-talk and permit-join
Room air sensors via zigbee2mqtt — current room temperatures (topics set on the settings page)

inputs.label: Push-to-talk (front SET)
inputs.behavior: One 10 s listening window, closed early by end of speech or a second press; amber LED + 'Listening…' bar; recognised command applies, otherwise 'Sorry, not understood' for 3 s.

inputs.label: "Hi ESP" fallback
inputs.behavior: Opens the same single-request window as the button; no audio kept or sent before that.

inputs.label: Room cards, −/+ , mic, permit-join
inputs.behavior: Tap a card to select (only its −/+ are live); ±0.5 °C within 5–30 °C, published immediately.

outputs.label: Dashboard
outputs.behavior: 2×2 room cards: name, current temp from air sensor, target from the TRV, heat/off tag; values not updated for 10 min greyed with last-seen time; footer shows MQTT state and clock.

outputs.label: Overlays
outputs.behavior: 'Listening…', 'Office → 21.0 °C', 'Already set', 'Sorry, not understood', 'Offline — controls disabled', 'Permit join for 4 minutes sent'.

outputs.label: Status LED
outputs.behavior: dim white breathing = connecting, green = online, amber = listening, red flash = rejected/offline; dim when idle.

outputs.label: TRV setpoint
outputs.behavior: Publishes {"current_heating_setpoint": "21.0"} to the TRV's state topic; the screen follows the TRV's own report — no mode change is ever sent.

connectivity.purpose: per-TRV state subscription, setpoint publish, zigbee2mqtt/bridge/request/permit_join
SoftAP + mDNS onboarding and settings page (broker, per-room TRV/sensor topics, names)
offline wake word + English one-shot recognition, no cloud

commissioning.payload: Wi-Fi SSID/password, MQTT broker URI + optional credentials, per-room TRV topic, air-sensor topic, display name
commissioning.instructions: Power over USB-C, LED breathes white; join the device's SoftAP and open http://korvo-heating.local; enter Wi-Fi, broker URI (e.g. mqtt://192.168.1.10:1883) and credentials; the four rooms come pre-filled with the owner's TRV topics (bathroom 0xa4c1383b5b3d7063, hallway 0xa4c13852a667eedf, office 0xa4c13829e3ee602b, living room 0xa4c13829aa5a7009) — add air-sensor topics and save; device reboots, screen fills with live values, LED green.

businessLogic.powerOnBehavior: Dashboard immediately with last saved targets greyed until MQTT state arrives; no splash/wizard on the panel; LED breathes white until Wi-Fi + broker are up.
automationRules: Room state derived from the TRV's single state payload: target = current_heating_setpoint, valve temp = local_temperature, mode = system_mode (missing mode or heating_cooling_mode:heat counts as heating); air sensor temperature is preferred for the current reading when fresh (<10 min).
Changes come only from the user (touch or voice); nothing is scheduled.
Re-publishing the same target within 30 s is suppressed with an 'Already set' banner.
Stale values (>10 min) greyed with last-seen time — the device does its own staleness check because zigbee2mqtt availability/last_seen are disabled here.
businessLogic.dayToDayOperation: Glance at four cards, tap a room and nudge it ±0.5 °C, or press the front button and say 'set the office to 21'; the card updates when the TRV reports back. The boiler stays manual.

factoryReset.trigger: Hold front SET + MODE together for 10 s (countdown on screen, LED solid red).
factoryReset.effect: Clears Wi-Fi, broker and room/topic table, restores default room names and TRV topics, reboots into SoftAP onboarding; TRV setpoints untouched.

failureModes.behavior: Last saved targets greyed, 'Offline — controls disabled', LED breathing then red flash, retries every 30 s.
Values freeze and grey, footer 'Offline', LED red flash; taps and voice refused (not queued).
Only that card greys out after 10 min with last-seen time; other rooms keep working.

failureModes.scenario: Room without a TRV named (kitchen, bedroom)
failureModes.behavior: 'Kitchen has no smart TRV', nothing published.
Returns on last saved targets; unacknowledged commands are not shown as applied.

powerManagement.sleepMode: Mains/USB powered, stays awake; LCD dims after 2 min idle, LED dim; touch/button/wake word/MQTT restores brightness.

report.customBehavior: No Home Assistant integration beyond plain zigbee2mqtt topics — setpoints are written into the TRV state topics directly. Room→topic mapping and names are settings-page data, not firmware constants, so re-pairing a valve is a topic edit. Europe/London assumed for the footer clock only.
